falseSynonyms.zh: connect 最廣泛，強調建立連接；link 常帶『把兩項關聯起來』或形成鏈接的意味。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The cable connects the printer to the computer. The report links higher costs to supply problems.

falseSynonyms.zh: join 常強調把兩個部分接成一體；link 可以更鬆散，只表示兩者有連接或關聯。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The tunnel joins the two buildings. The road links the village with the city.

falseSynonyms.zh: associate 側重概念上的聯想／關聯，不表示實體或技術接通。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON People associate the brand with reliability. The cable links the two devices.

falseSynonyms.zh: hyperlink 是數碼文件／網頁中的可點擊跳轉連結，是 link 的特定技術子類。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Click the hyperlink in the document. The railway link connects the airport and city centre.

falseSynonyms.zh: web link 專指網上資源連結；普通 link 還可指道路、關係、證據和技術連接。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Send me the web link. The evidence established a link between the two events.

falseSynonyms.zh: attach 強調把一物附加／固定到另一物；link 不一定有物理附着。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Attach the label to the box. The path links the park to the station.

falseSynonyms.zh: URL 是網頁地址；link 是可以指向該 URL 的可點擊元素或更廣義的連接。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Paste the URL into the browser. Click the link in the email.

falseSynonyms.zh: link 可作動詞／名詞；linkage 是較正式的名詞，表示關聯或連接關係。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The study links diet to health. The study found a linkage between diet and health.
